== Summary ==
Original slip, 19 June 2003: Found Someone You Have (V), as printed on the Players Committee's revised sheet of 19 June 2003 for [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]].

'''Old pre-template slip''' (before the Committee's December 2006 Remaster template).

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (Players Committee, 19 June 2003; PDF dated 11 June 2003; copy still hosted by the Players Committee at res.starwarsccg.org), page 1, slip 7. The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the slip (with its printed label above it) cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Found Someone You Have (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)]].
